Khronos Vulkan-Headers 1.3.275, unmodified C headers copied from the Unity
6000.3.17f1 Android NDK sysroot. Only the core, Win32 and dependent video headers
are included. These headers are Apache-2.0 licensed; see LICENSE.md and each
file's copyright notice. They are used to compile the Windows Vulkan external
memory bridge, which dynamically resolves the installed Vulkan loader.

Upstream: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers/tree/v1.3.275
